newsitem.title: USA: Talbots remains cautious on outlook.
newsitem.headline: Talbots remains cautious on outlook.

text.p: Talbots Inc said Tuesday it remained cautious on its fiscal 1997 outlook but was still committed to the expansion of the Talbots brand and planned to open 70 new stores in the year.

"Although we remain cautious in our outlook for fiscal 1997, we continue to believe that our focused strategies and disciplined approach to growth will ensure Talbots long-term success," said Chief Executive Arnold Zetcher in a statement accompanying the company's fourth quarter results.
A spokeswoman for Talbots told Reuters that given "current trends in our business," the company was taking a cautious approach to growth in fiscal 1997. She declined to elaborate.
Talbots said its store expansion would bring its total store count to 605 at the end of fiscal 1997, up from 435 at the end of fiscal 1996.
The company also said it plans to expand its Talbots Babies concept into existing Talbots Kids stores, and its Talbots Intimates business into existing Talbots Misses stores.
The crux of its growth strategy continues to be the expansion of its core Misses and Petites business, the company said.
